name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: The dashboard's breadcrumb: subtle gray links, 14px chevrons between them, and the current page in black.
usage: Show where a detail page sits under its list (Batches, then a batch ID) and let people step back up. Put it above the page title. Set an ID in mono, as the dashboard sets a batch's, and collapse middle levels into BreadcrumbEllipsis when the trail is long.
avoid: A breadcrumb on a top-level page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.

exampleFiles.content:
import { Slash } from "lucide-react";

import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";

export function Site() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#docs">Docs</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#apis">APIs</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Brand API</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Product() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#batches">Batches</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage className="font-mono text-caption">batch_7c1e9a04f2</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Collapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#monitors">Monitors</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#checks">Checks</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <Slash strokeWidth={1.5} />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Oct 24, 09:12</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}
